value.rationale: The March 2026 tree-ASEP article motivates branch network design for proton transport, but supplies selected geometry currents rather than a universal bound. Here an exact all-network finite-size rule rules out current improvement by any same-direction tree bias at half-total-filling, with sharp equality classification, a quantitative positive deficit polynomial and a two-leaf opposing-bias counterexample showing the boundary is genuine. This is a naturally motivated transport optimization classification, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
